title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Routine follow-up for end stage renal disease and hypertension.

History of Present Illness
The patient presents for routine follow-up. He has a known history of end stage renal disease, which he manages with regular care. He also has a history of hypertension. He reports adherence to his current medication regimen and denies any acute complaints or changes in status since the last visit. His vital signs were stable upon arrival.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10 mg daily
Furosemide 40 mg daily

Exam
Vitals: BP 138/86, HR 78, Temp 98.4°F. Physical exam is unremarkable; no acute findings noted in the cardiovascular or pulmonary systems.

Assessment
1. End stage renal disease: Stable.
2. Hypertension: Well-controlled on current regimen.

Plan
Continue current medications as prescribed. Follow up in three months for routine monitoring. Encourage dietary salt restriction for optimal management of end stage renal disease and hypertension.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD stage 5 or ESRD: I12.0, plus N18.5/N18.6.
ESRD: N18.6. If a stage and ESRD are both documented, assign N18.6 only.

distractors.why: I12.9 is for stage 1-4 or unspecified CKD.
The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
Assign N18.6 only when ESRD is documented.
